description: 網路服務提供者民事免責事由問答集 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部智慧財產局. 由於各類網路侵權行為皆需透過網路服務提供者（Internet Service Provider, ISP）提供之服務予以遂行，造成ISP時常需面對被控侵權之訴訟風險，實不利網路產業之發展。 智慧財產局為解決此一問題，爰參考國際間各國作法，於98年5月13日公布新增著作權法第6章之1「網路服務提供者之民事免責事由」條文。 為使ISP業者及各... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部智慧財產局. Its tags are 開創事業. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
